manifest.terminology: scenario = one parameter combination (one row of scenario_manifest.csv); contrast cell = scenario x contrast (3 per scenario: B-A, C-A confirmatory; B-C exploratory); every estimator is applied to the same simulated trials

type1_error_base_nulls.note: 96 contrast cells (48 null scenarios x B-A, C-A) per J, 2,000 replications each (MC SE ~0.0049 at 0.05; 95% MC band 0.0404-0.0596)

power_headline.note: R2 0.3, cluster-size CV 0.3, 10% MCAR attrition, d for both B and C vs A; 1,000 replications; 'holm_*' = Holm-adjusted marginal power per contrast; 'holm_both' = probability of rejecting both; analytic = unadjusted alpha 0.05 noncentral-t on J-c df (Eldridge design effect)

analytic_mdes.note: ANALYTIC (closed-form), unadjusted, 80% power, noncentral-t approximation on J-c df; alpha 0.025 rows are a Bonferroni approximation, not Holm

clusters_needed_80pct_power_d0.3.note: planned analysis LMM t(J-c), c = 10 (two offerings x 4 strata), J split equally over two offerings, R2 0.3, CV 0.3, 10% attrition, equal allocation, 2,000 replications per grid J; marginal = Holm-adjusted power of EACH confirmatory contrast >= 0.80 (min of B-A and C-A); joint = P(both rejected) >= 0.80

sensitivity_J56.note: J = 56 (c = 10, df 46), equal 10:9:9 per offering, R2 0.3, CV 0.3, d 0.3, 10% MCAR attrition unless varied; size = unadjusted rejection of a true-null contrast (2,000 replications); power = Holm-adjusted marginal (1,000 replications); S3 truth is on the raw 0-100 scale

legacy_reproduction.note: v2 code with the fixed v1 layout and the v1 seeds reproduces v1 J=28 results (R2 0.3, CV 0.3, both allocations, all ICC and d); residual differences are numerical noise

full_rerun_with_per_replicate_randomisat.note: same data streams as v1, but fresh allocation per replicate; differences are Monte Carlo variation (z treats the two runs as independent; they share data streams, so z is approximate)

design.randomisation: fresh stratified allocation per simulated trial (extras {A,A,B,C} permuted over the 4 strata of each offering; arm labels permuted over groups within each stratum)
